title: Aisle 4 dock crossing — blind corner at staged pallets
description: Synthetic reference scenario. A counterbalance forklift travels east along Aisle 4 while a pedestrian walks north from the packing office to the dock office, crossing the aisle beside a pallet stack staged in the marshalling area. The stack hides the pedestrian from the driver until the pedestrian is about to enter the aisle.

incident.summary: Forklift FL-07 stopped short of a pedestrian stepping out from behind staged pallets.
incident.narrative: At about 14:05 forklift FL-07, unladen, was travelling east along Aisle 4 at roughly normal aisle speed. A picker carrying a tote walked north from the packing office toward the dock office using the painted crossing at X-23. Pallet stack A had been staged in the marshalling area just west of the crossing that morning, about 2.2 m high. The driver said they did not see the picker until the picker stepped past the stack, braked hard, and stopped with the forks roughly a third of a metre away. The picker said they did not look left because the stack was in the way. No contact, no injury. CCTV covers the crossing; the truck's telematics recorded speed.
